excluded_probe.reason: FLEDD returned IRET=0 but EQTIM=0 and repeated the 5.1 s grid; excluded from inference

method.flux: FL7 is the sole absolute loop; raw loop L!=7 is differential to FL7. Compare raw Wb/(2*pi) directly with SELENE COCOS 2 psi_L-psi_7 at the two sensor positions, without a fitted slice offset. For FL7 compare raw/(2*pi) with absolute psi_7, recognizing a snapshot absolute-level difference. Transform psi_17=2*pi*psi_2 before comparing inferred raw-to-target sign with the imas-alambic COCOS 17 channel_factor.
method.pickup: Use SELENE COCOS 2 Br=(dpsi/dZ)/R and Bz=-(dpsi/dR)/R at the probe. The earlier geometric normal N=(-sin omega,cos omega) is opposite the DD directed sensing axis (sin omega,-cos omega), with DD poloidal_angle=(90 deg-omega) mod 360 deg. The measured -B dot N therefore has positive sign along the DD axis; physical B and the directed axis have no 2pi scalar factor on conversion to COCOS 17.
method.rogowski: Compare each raw current with SELENE TTCU or SA G-EQDSK current at the named shot. Sign inference requires at least 10% of reference current in both shots.
method.toroidal: PSC/oTFCur is PID 1625 O293; outeddb.c uses positive factor 2.25*2.96/25.7 to produce BTV in T m.
method.profile: Read per-record coordinate selector rather than assign one coordinate system to all profiles.
